By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], [[Dark Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate owned an '''armored luxury coach''' [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]], which he used as a mode of transportation in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]].
